facts.claim: Le Bellot (Ponant): Entered service 2020; 37,000 GT; 184 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 217 m length; Explorer class.
Le Bellot is the fifth ship of the Ponant Explorers class of cruise ships operated by Ponant.
Each member of the class has been allocated the name of a famous French explorer, and Le Bellot is named after Joseph René Bellot, a French naval officer and Arctic explorer.
